attchmntText: ICSA (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: I.C.S.A. India Limited approved the standalone unaudited financial results for the half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 14 November 2026. The company is in liquidation. The National Company Law Tribunal ordered liquidation on 18 August 2020. The liquidation process closed on 7 February 2023. The company was sold as a going concern. Assets were disposed of. Land was sold for Rs. 900.00 lakhs. A vehicle was sold for Rs. 3.05 lakhs. Total realization was Rs. 10,23,89,263. These funds were distributed to stakeholders. All financial figures in the results are reported as zero. The auditor noted the sale and granted immunities for past defaults. Venkateswar Nellutla is the Managing Director.
